metadata.description: Learning Producers' own marketplace: the Combat Writing plugin and its local add-on.

plugins.name: cw
plugins.description: Combat Writing (/cw) for Claude Code: two fresh readers attack your draft. Each rates it 1 to 10, 7 forbidden, and says why. They read each other in the sharing rounds and rate again when you ask. With the add-on, combat-writing-crew, other companies' models join the crew on your own API keys, in the second reader's chair.

plugins.name: combat-writing-crew
plugins.description: The Combat Writing add-on: a local MCP server that sends each seat's packet to other companies' models on your own API keys, each key only to its own provider. One free Groq key seats two outside models beside the fresh reader, a crew of three. Built for Claude Code: a local MCP server is ignored in chat on claude.ai and loads in the desktop app only on your own computer.
